in_marathi.name: Devkiransh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's (Deva) graceful (Kiransh) form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devkiransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devkiransh is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: Deva (God) and Kiransh (graceful form). The name represents the divine grace bestowed upon an individual. It signifies the blessings of the gods and the manifestation of their presence in one's life.
